subject: Private deployment topology — SOC 2 / SIG evidence & quick clarifications
messages:
From: Maya Ramesh <maya@greenline.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenline.com
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment topology and evidence for SOC 2/SIG

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Greenline's security team wants to validate the proposed private deployment for our PII workloads before moving forward with procurement. Could you share: 

- A tidy topology diagram showing control-plane vs data-plane boundaries for the Private (VPC) option, annotated with where KMS, audit logs, and customer-managed routing live.
- A short narrative (1 page) that maps those elements to typical SOC 2 / SIG control families (e.g., Logging/Monitoring, Network Segmentation, Key Management).
- Any evidence artifacts you can share now (diagram PNG, high-level control matrix template).

We have a compressed timeline: security has their review meeting on Wed 17th. If you can get an initial packet by Tuesday EOD (16th), that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Maya Ramesh
Director of Security Engineering
Greenline Analytics

P.S. Procurement looped in for contract timing/questions.

From: avery_johnson@redwood.com
To: Maya Ramesh <maya@greenline.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment topology and evidence for SOC 2/SIG

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the clear ask and timeline. Quick plan:

1) Kimberly will produce an annotated topology PNG that separates control-plane and data-plane with labels for KMS/HSM boundaries, audit log sinks, and egress control points.
2) Karthik will assemble a one-page narrative mapping those elements to SIG/SOC 2 families and call out any compensating controls.
3) I'll package a minimal control-matrix skeleton (columns for control objective, evidence, owner, last-updated) and include file stubs you can drop into your intake.

We can deliver an initial packet by Tue 16th 5:00pm PT. Can you confirm the scope: do you want the diagram oriented to Greenline's proposed VPC peering (us-west-2) or a region-agnostic view? Also confirm whether Greenline requires an air-gapped / on-prem variant or just VPC + Private offering.

Cheers,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Private deployment topology — initial topology + artifact list attached

Maya, Avery —

Attached is the initial packet for your review:
- redwood_private_topology_v1.png (single-sheet annotated topology; control-plane = purple, data-plane = blue)
- control_mapping_skeleton.xlsx (control matrix skeleton keyed to SOC 2 / SIG families)

Notes and calls-to-action in the diagram:
- KMS: customer-managed keys are drawn inside your VPC boundary with a labeled key-access policy. For customers who prefer HSM-based key isolation, we call that out as an option (requires additional onboarding).
- Audit logs: immutable audit sink is shown off-VPC to an encrypted logging project. Logs are retained per customer retention policy — we can supply retention artifacts for SOC 2 evidence.
- Egress: we show default deny egress with a small set of permitted endpoints (control plane, metrics exporters, and Redshift-like permitted targets). If you require explicit IP allowlists, note that costs/latency vary by region.

Open questions for you (quick yes/no):
1) Region: confirm us-west-2 for Greenline — yes?
2) Do you need an on-prem/air-gapped variant in the packet, or is VPC-only sufficient for the upcoming review?

If those are green, Karthik and I will produce the 1-page SIG/SOC mapping and a short evidence legend by tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Architect, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_private_topology_v1.png, control_mapping_skeleton.xlsx

From: Maya Ramesh <maya@greenline.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenline.com
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment topology — initial topology + artifact list attached

Thanks, Kimberly — this is helpful and the diagram looks good at a glance. A couple of clarifications before we show to the board:

- Region: Confirmed — please tailor the packet to us-west-2.
- On-prem: not required for phase 1, VPC-only is fine.
- Can you add a very short subsection in the narrative that explains how tenant separation is enforced at the network and runtime layer (specifics around host tenancy, namespaces, and any hardware-enforced boundaries)? The SOC reviewer likes crisp calls-out about "logical vs physical" separation.

Procurement: please keep track of any constraints that might affect the contract (e.g., HSM add-on, retention SLAs).

If you can add the tenant separation sentence and send the completed packet by EOD today, we'll queue it into the Wed meeting.

Best,
Maya
